instruction: Use the right hand to pick up the glass, place it under the Coca-Cola dispenser, and press the lever to fill it

events.description: The glass stays near the right-side cup area rather than under the dispenser nozzle.
No clear lever press is visible before or during the liquid appearance.
Red liquid appears in the glass with no visible dispenser stream, nozzle contact, or lever activation.
The glass goes from empty to filled with red liquid without any visible fluid-flow path.
The glass ends up filled, but the place–press–fill procedure is not completed in a verifiable sequence.
